items.headline: Georgia commit, DL Marcellus Young Casario died after 'sudden medical emergency'
items.description: Georgia football commit, three-star defensive lineman Marcellus Young Casario died Friday after experiencing a "sudden medical emergency," according to his high school.

items.headline: Where No. 22 Missouri stands against an electric No. 1 Georgia offense?
items.description: The SEC Nation crew analyze the dominance behind the Bulldogs' offensive unit as they discuss what the Tigers must keep in mind in order to have a chance to come out with a win.

items.headline: Smart explains how Stockton has taught him more than X's and O's can
items.description: Kirby Smart joins The Paul Finebaum Show to preview the No. 1 Bulldogs' matchup against No. 22 Missouri and details how Gunner Stockton makes everyone around him better.

items.headline: FAA ground stop throws sports world into travel chaos ahead of weekend games
items.description: Travel plans for teams in multiple sports were disrupted by the FAA's nationwide ground stop of all flights because of communications problems.

items.headline: Sean McDonough on No. 1 UGA: 'The gold standard in college football'
items.description: McDonough joins The Paul Finebaum Show and discusses why the Bulldogs are the top team in the nation and why Alabama is at the No. 3 spot.
